groups.name: entity
groups.title: entity
groups.doc: The entity the script is attached to (also `other` in collisions, and results of game.find()).

members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id of this entity.

members.name: name
members.doc: Object type name (clones share it), e.g. "Coin".

members.name: tags
members.doc: Tags of this entity (read-only set). Use hasTag/addTag.

members.name: destroyed
members.doc: True once the entity has been destroyed.

members.name: position
members.doc: Local position in meters. Writable: entity.position.y += 1

members.name: rotation
members.doc: Local rotation in DEGREES. Writable: entity.rotation.y += 90 * dt

members.name: scale
members.doc: Local scale. Writable: entity.scale.x = 2

members.name: visible
members.doc: Show / hide the entity.

members.name: enabled
members.doc: Disabled entities are not updated or drawn.

members.name: getVar
members.doc: Read an instance variable.

members.name: setVar
members.doc: Write an instance variable.

members.name: hasTag
members.doc: Does this entity have the tag? e.g. other.hasTag("enemy")

members.name: addTag
members.doc: Add a tag.

members.name: removeTag
members.doc: Remove a tag.

members.name: getWorldPosition
members.doc: Position in world space (includes parents).

members.name: getForward
members.doc: Unit vector the entity faces (world space).

members.name: setPosition
members.doc: Teleport to a position.

members.name: translate
members.doc: Move by an offset in world axes.

members.name: moveLocal
members.doc: Move along its own axes (x right, y up, z forward).

members.name: setRotation
members.doc: Set rotation in degrees.

members.name: rotate
members.doc: Rotate by degrees, e.g. entity.rotate(0, 90 * dt, 0)

members.name: lookAt
members.doc: Turn to face a world point.

members.name: moveToward
members.doc: Move up to `distance` meters toward a point.

members.name: distanceTo
members.doc: Distance to another entity or {x,y,z}.

members.name: hasBody
members.doc: Has a RigidBody component?

members.name: getVelocity
members.doc: Physics velocity (m/s).

members.name: setVelocity
members.doc: Set physics velocity.

members.name: applyImpulse
members.doc: Instant push, e.g. a jump: applyImpulse(0, 5, 0)

members.name: applyForce
members.doc: Continuous push (call every frame).

members.name: isOnGround
members.doc: True if a dynamic body rests on something.

members.name: setColor
members.doc: Change material color, e.g. setColor("#ff0000")

members.name: setOpacity
members.doc: Change material opacity.

members.name: setText
members.doc: Set the text of a Text component.

members.name: getText
members.doc: Get the text of a Text component.

members.name: getUIValue
members.doc: Slider (or bar) value (UI component).

members.name: setUIValue
members.doc: Set the slider value, e.g. health.

members.name: getUIMax
members.doc: Slider maximum.

members.name: setUIMax
members.doc: Set the slider maximum.

members.name: getUIMin
members.doc: Slider minimum.

members.name: setUIMin
members.doc: Set the slider minimum.

members.name: setUIImage
members.doc: Change the image of a UI element.

members.name: setUIColors
members.doc: Change UI colors, e.g. { background: "#ff0000" }.

members.name: setUIInteractable
members.doc: Grey a button or slider out, or turn it back on (Interactable).

members.name: getUIPosition
members.doc: Where a UI element sits: its anchored position in canvas pixels from its anchor.

members.name: setUIPosition
members.doc: Move a UI element to this anchored position (canvas px). Leave an axis out (undefined) to keep it.

members.name: refreshUI
members.doc: Re-apply the UI styles after writing component data directly.

members.name: isPressed
members.doc: True while this UI button is held down.

members.name: playAnimation
members.doc: Play a clip of the 3D model, e.g. "walk" or "jump". loop=false plays once and holds the last frame.

members.name: stopAnimation
members.doc: Stop the playing model animation.

members.name: getAnimation
members.doc: Name of the playing clip (empty if none).

members.name: isAnimationBusy
members.doc: True while a play-once animation (loop off) is still running.

members.name: getAnimationNames
members.doc: All clip names of the model.

members.name: hasAnimation
members.doc: True if the model has this clip.

members.name: setAnimationSpeed
members.doc: 1 = normal, 0.5 = half, 2 = double.

members.name: setSpriteFrame
members.doc: Sprite: show one frame (0 = the first) and stop its animation. playAnimation() plays the frames again.

members.name: getSpriteFrame
members.doc: Sprite: the frame being shown (0 = the first).

members.name: getSpriteFrameCount
members.doc: Sprite: how many frames it has.

members.name: tween
members.doc: Animate 'x' | 'y' | 'z' | 'angle' | 'size' | 'opacity' to a value, e.g. tween('size', 1.5, 0.3, 'back'). Eases: linear, easeIn, easeOut, easeInOut, back, elastic, bounce.

members.name: isTweening
members.doc: A tween is running (of that property, or any).

members.name: stopTweens
members.doc: Stop all tweens where they are.

members.name: attachTo
members.doc: Carry this object along with another (keeps its place in the world), e.g. a picked-up key.

members.name: detach
members.doc: Let go: back to the top level where it is now.

members.name: particleSystem
members.doc: The Particle System (like Unity's): every module live — particleSystem.main.startSpeed = 8, particleSystem.noise.enabled = true — plus play(), pause(), stop(), emit(count, params), simulate(t), getParticles() / setParticles(). Null without a Particles component.

members.name: emitParticles
members.doc: Shoot particles at once from the Particle System, e.g. emitParticles(30) on a hit.

members.name: startParticles
members.doc: Play the Particle System (bursts at time 0 go out). Safe to call every frame: already playing means nothing changes.

members.name: restartParticles
members.doc: Play the Particle System from the beginning even if it is already playing.

members.name: stopParticles
members.doc: Stop making new particles; the ones out finish their life, or go at once with stopParticles(true).

members.name: setParticleRate
members.doc: Emission rate over time (particles per second).

members.name: isEmittingParticles
members.doc: True while the Particle System makes new particles.

members.name: getParticleCount
members.doc: Particles currently alive.

members.name: playSound
members.doc: Play this entity's Audio component.

members.name: stopSound
members.doc: Stop this entity's Audio component.

members.name: getComponent
members.doc: A copy of a component's or behavior's settings, e.g. getComponent("rigidbody").mass. Read-only — component() gives you the live one.

members.name: component
members.doc: A component as a live object: every setting in the Inspector is a property you can read and write, e.g. component("rigidbody").mass = 5, component("light").intensity = 2. Structural ones (shape, model) need rebuild() — component(type).set({ … }) does it for you.

members.name: getComponents
members.doc: Component types on this object.

members.name: addComponent
members.doc: Add a component and rebuild, e.g. addComponent("rigidbody", { mass: 2 }). Types: mesh, collider, rigidbody, light, camera, text, ui, audio, particles, terrain, water, sprite.

members.name: removeComponent
members.doc: Remove a component and rebuild.

members.name: rebuild
members.doc: Rebuild the object from its components (3D content, body, text, UI, particles, behaviors), keeping where it is and its variables.

members.name: hasComponent
members.doc: Does it have this component or behavior? e.g. other.hasComponent("health")

members.name: getScript
members.doc: What a code script on this object exports, e.g. other.getScript("Enemy")?.hit(1). In that script: export function hit(n) { … }

members.name: behavior
members.doc: A behavior as a live object: its settings are properties (behavior("platformer").speed = 8) and it has its own readings and methods, e.g. behavior("car").speed, behavior("platformer").jump(), behavior("health").health. Null without that behavior.

members.name: getBehaviors
members.doc: Behavior types on this object.

members.name: addBehavior
members.doc: Add a behavior and start it now, e.g. addBehavior("bullet", { speed: 20 })

members.name: removeBehavior
members.doc: Stop and remove a behavior.

members.name: setBehaviorEnabled
members.doc: Enable/disable a behavior, e.g. ("platformer", false)

members.name: getBehaviorParam
members.doc: Read a behavior parameter.

members.name: setBehaviorParam
members.doc: Change a behavior parameter, e.g. ("platformer", "speed", 8)

members.name: damage
members.doc: Health behavior: lose health; from = what hit it (for Knockback). Fires On hurt / On death.

members.name: heal
members.doc: Health behavior: get health back, up to Max health. Current health: getVar("health").

members.name: moveTo
members.doc: Walk to a point on the ground (default speed 3, around walls), playing walk / idle clips. onArrived() runs there. options: { avoidWalls: false, animate: false, sprintSpeed: 8 }

members.name: stopMoving
members.doc: Cancel moveTo().

members.name: movingTo
members.doc: A moveTo() is under way.

members.name: inWater
members.doc: In a Water object (a physics body: any part of it).

members.name: enterVehicle
members.doc: Get into a Boat or Car: ride in its seat; cameras follow it. It does not steer it: pass the input in with driveCar / setMoveInput.

members.name: exitVehicle
members.doc: Get out, beside the vehicle (on land if possible).

members.name: driveCar
members.doc: Drive a Car this frame: steer −1 (left) … 1 (right), gas and brake 0 … 1. Call it every frame the controls are held; calls in one frame merge, so steering and gas from two places both arrive.

members.name: setMoveInput
members.doc: Move a Platformer, Top-down or Boat this frame: right/left (x) and forward/back (y), −1 … 1. Call it every frame the input is held; calls in one frame merge.

members.name: simulateControl
members.doc: Press controls for this frame, like a key would: "left", "right", "up" (gas / forward), "down" (brake / reverse), "jump", "handbrake". Several at once: simulateControl("left", "up"). Works on Platformer, Top-down, Car and Boat.

members.name: vehicle
members.doc: The vehicle it is riding, or null.

members.name: hasDriver
members.doc: A boat or car someone got into (Enter vehicle).

members.name: getParent
members.doc: Parent entity.

members.name: getChildren
members.doc: Child entities.

members.name: destroy
members.doc: Remove the entity (at end of frame).

members.name: object3d
members.doc: Advanced: the underlying three.js object.

members.name: project
members.doc: The whole project data (read-only).

members.name: scene
members.doc: Current scene data (read-only).

members.name: time
members.doc: Seconds since the scene started.

members.name: dt
members.doc: Last frame time in seconds.

members.name: timeScale
members.doc: Game speed: 1 normal, 0.5 slow motion.

members.name: paused
members.doc: Is the game paused?

members.name: loadingProgress
members.doc: On a loading screen: how far it got, 0 … 1 (assets loaded and time held, whichever is further behind). Draw a loading bar with it; the game moves on when it reaches 1.

members.name: isLoading
members.doc: A loading screen is up and the game has not moved on yet.

members.name: input
members.doc: Same as `input`.

members.name: audio
members.doc: Same as `audio`.

members.name: screen
members.doc: Screen size in pixels.

members.name: select
members.doc: All entities by name or #tag: game.select("#enemy")

members.name: find
members.doc: First entity with that name/id: game.find("Player")

members.name: getAllEntities
members.doc: Every live entity.

members.name: spawn
members.doc: Create a prefab / clone: game.spawn("Coin", {x:0,y:5,z:0})

members.name: create
members.doc: Make a brand-new object other scripts and event sheets can find: game.create({name:"Portal", shape:"torus", position:{x:0,y:2,z:0}, color:"#8f6fff"}). Put your own three.js meshes inside its .object3d.

members.name: destroy
members.doc: Destroy an entity.

members.name: pick
members.doc: Entity at a screen point.

members.name: touchWorld
members.doc: The spot in the world under the finger / mouse (a surface, else the ground plane). Tap to move: player.moveTo(p.x, p.z).

members.name: hasLineOfSight
members.doc: True when nothing solid is between the two objects, e.g. an enemy can see the player.

members.name: raycast
members.doc: Physics ray between two world points.

members.name: isTouching
members.doc: Are two entities touching?

members.name: touchInfo
members.doc: Current contact of two touching entities (point, normal, speed, impulse), or null

members.name: getVar
members.doc: Read a global/scene variable: game.getVar("Score")

members.name: setVar
members.doc: Write a global/scene variable.

members.name: hasVar
members.doc: Does the variable exist?

members.name: goToScene
members.doc: Switch scene.

members.name: restartScene
members.doc: Restart the current scene.

members.name: pause
members.doc: Pause the game.

members.name: resume
members.doc: Resume the game.

members.name: save
members.doc: Save a value on the device (high scores...).

members.name: load
members.doc: Load a saved value.

members.name: getCamera
members.doc: The active camera entity.

members.name: three
members.doc: Advanced: the three.js renderer, scene and camera behind the game, e.g. game.three.scene.add(mesh).

members.name: rapier
members.doc: Advanced: the physics engine behind the game. game.rapier.world is the Rapier World, game.rapier.bodyOf(entity) / collidersOf(entity) its objects, game.rapier.setGravity(x, y, z) the world gravity. Use it with RAPIER.

members.name: spawnParticles
members.doc: Play an effect once at a position: "Sparkles", "Fire", "Smoke", "Explosion", "Dust puff", "Rain", "Confetti", "Splash", "Bubbles", "Magic". overrides change any module, e.g. { main: { startColor: "#ff0000" }, noise: { enabled: true } }

members.name: shakeCamera
members.doc: Shake the camera.

members.name: debug
members.doc: Draw shapes over the game to check positions and sizes, like Unity Debug.DrawLine and Gizmos: game.debug.drawSphere(enemy.position, 5, "#ff0000"), drawLine(a, b, color, seconds), drawRay(origin, direction), drawCircle(center, radius), drawBox(center, size), drawPoint(position). Seconds default to 0 = one frame, so call it every update().

members.name: vibrate
members.doc: Vibrate the phone, e.g. vibrate(40) on a hit (Android; ignored elsewhere).

members.name: on
members.doc: Listen: "sceneStart", "collisionStart", "entityCreated", "waterEnter", ...

members.name: log
members.doc: Show a message on screen (debugging).

members.name: axis
members.doc: Joystick / WASD / arrows / gamepad stick, each in -1..1. y = forward.

members.name: look
members.doc: Look this frame in degrees: locked mouse, gamepad right stick or a drag. x = right, y = up.

members.name: gamepad
members.doc: A gamepad has been used. Its buttons work as keys: "PadA", "PadB", "PadX", "PadY", "PadLB", "PadRB", "PadLT", "PadRT", "PadStart".

members.name: isDown
members.doc: Button, key or gamepad button held, e.g. input.isDown("jump"), input.isDown("Space"), input.isDown("PadA")

members.name: wasPressed
members.doc: Button or key pressed this frame.

members.name: wasReleased
members.doc: Button or key released this frame.

members.name: pointer
members.doc: Finger / mouse position in pixels.

members.name: tapped
members.doc: A tap happened this frame.

members.name: swipe
members.doc: Swipe direction this frame.

members.name: tappedEntity
members.doc: Entity under the finger when tapped this frame.

members.name: play
members.doc: Play an audio asset, e.g. audio.play("coin")

members.name: stop
members.doc: Stop sounds with a tag (or all).

members.name: setMasterVolume
members.doc: Global volume.

members.name: lerp
members.doc: Blend from a to b by t (0..1).

members.name: clamp
members.doc: Keep v between min and max.

members.name: random
members.doc: Random decimal number between min and max.

members.name: randomInt
members.doc: Random whole number between min and max (inclusive).

members.name: deg2rad
members.doc: Degrees to radians (for Math.sin etc.).

members.name: object
members.doc: In const properties = { … }: a field where each object picks another object in the Inspector, e.g. target: object(). Read it as props.target.

groups.name: collision
groups.title: collision
groups.doc: Second argument of onCollision / onCollisionStay / onCollisionEnd (third for game scripts): what was hit, where and how hard (like Unity's Collision).

members.name: other
members.doc: The object it hit.

members.name: self
members.doc: The object this collision is reported to.

members.name: isTrigger
members.doc: One of them is a trigger: they overlap, no contacts.

members.name: contacts
members.doc: Every contact: { point, normal, separation, impulse }. World space; normals point out of `other`.

members.name: contactCount
members.doc: How many contacts.

members.name: point
members.doc: Where they touched (first contact).

members.name: normal
members.doc: Surface direction at the hit, out of `other` toward this object (y = 1: landed on top of it).

members.name: impulse
members.doc: Total impulse that pushed this object away (N·s); its length is how hard they hit.

members.name: relativeVelocity
members.doc: Velocity of `other` relative to this object as they met (m/s).

members.name: speed
members.doc: Impact speed (length of relativeVelocity), e.g. for damage or a sound volume.

members.name: collider
members.doc: The other object's collider that touched.

members.name: thisCollider
members.doc: This object's collider that touched.

members.name: rigidbody
members.doc: The other object's physics body.

members.name: flipped
members.doc: The same collision from the other object's side.

groups.name: particleSystem
groups.title: entity.particleSystem
groups.doc: An object's Particle System, like Unity's ParticleSystem.

members.name: main
members.doc: The main module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: emission
members.doc: The emission module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: shape
members.doc: The shape module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: velocityOverLifetime
members.doc: The velocityOverLifetime module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: limitVelocityOverLifetime
members.doc: The limitVelocityOverLifetime module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: inheritVelocity
members.doc: The inheritVelocity module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: lifetimeByEmitterSpeed
members.doc: The lifetimeByEmitterSpeed module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: forceOverLifetime
members.doc: The forceOverLifetime module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: colorOverLifetime
members.doc: The colorOverLifetime module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: colorBySpeed
members.doc: The colorBySpeed module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: sizeOverLifetime
members.doc: The sizeOverLifetime module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: sizeBySpeed
members.doc: The sizeBySpeed module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: rotationOverLifetime
members.doc: The rotationOverLifetime module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: rotationBySpeed
members.doc: The rotationBySpeed module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: noise
members.doc: The noise module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: collision
members.doc: The collision module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: triggers
members.doc: The triggers module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: subEmitters
members.doc: The subEmitters module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: textureSheetAnimation
members.doc: The textureSheetAnimation module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: lights
members.doc: The lights module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: trails
members.doc: The trails module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: renderer
members.doc: The renderer module, live: change any setting (the same names as the Inspector). Numbers can be a constant or { mode: "twoConstants", constantMin, constantMax, … }.

members.name: isPlaying
members.doc: Playing (emitting, or particles still flying), not paused.

members.name: isEmitting
members.doc: Making new particles.

members.name: isPaused
members.doc: Paused.

members.name: isStopped
members.doc: Stopped and every particle gone.

members.name: particleCount
members.doc: Particles alive.

members.name: time
members.doc: Seconds into the current cycle (settable).

members.name: play
members.doc: Play (or carry on after pause).

members.name: pause
members.doc: Freeze in place.

members.name: stop
members.doc: Stop emitting; "stopEmittingAndClear" also removes the particles.

members.name: clear
members.doc: Remove every particle.

members.name: isAlive
members.doc: Emitting or particles still alive.

members.name: emit
members.doc: Emit now. params override start values: { position, velocity, startSize, startColor, startLifetime, rotation, … }.

members.name: simulate
members.sig: (t, withChildren = true, restart = true, fixedTimeStep = true)
members.doc: Fast-forward t seconds (leaves it paused).

members.name: getParticles
members.doc: Every live particle: position, velocity, remainingLifetime, startSize, startColor, rotation, … (a copy).

members.name: setParticles
members.doc: Write particles back (change getParticles() results); extra ones are removed.

members.name: triggerSubEmitter
members.doc: Fire a sub emitter from every particle, or the given ones.

lifecycle.name: start
lifecycle.doc: Called once when the scene starts.

lifecycle.name: update
lifecycle.doc: Called every frame. dt = seconds since last frame.

lifecycle.name: onCollision
lifecycle.doc: This entity started touching `other`. collision has the details: contacts, point, normal, impulse, relativeVelocity, speed, isTrigger.

lifecycle.name: onCollisionStay
lifecycle.doc: Every frame while it touches `other` (only define it if you need it: it reads every contact).

lifecycle.name: onParticleCollision
lifecycle.doc: Particles hit `other` (Collision module with Send Collision Messages). Called on the system's object and on the one hit. events: [{ intersection, normal, velocity, other }].

lifecycle.name: onParticleTrigger
lifecycle.doc: Particles met the Triggers module's colliders (actions set to Callback). events: [{ type: "inside" | "outside" | "enter" | "exit", particles }].

lifecycle.name: onParticleSystemStopped
lifecycle.doc: Its Particle System stopped and the last particle died (Stop Action: Callback).

lifecycle.name: onArrived
lifecycle.doc: It reached the point of entity.moveTo() (or got as close as it could).

lifecycle.name: onDestroy
lifecycle.doc: This entity is about to be destroyed.

helpers.name: lerp
helpers.doc: Blend from a to b by t (0..1).

helpers.name: clamp
helpers.doc: Keep v between min and max.

helpers.name: random
helpers.doc: Random decimal number between min and max.

helpers.name: randomInt
helpers.doc: Random whole number between min and max (inclusive).

helpers.name: object
helpers.doc: In const properties = { … }: a field where each object picks another object in the Inspector, e.g. target: object(). Read it as props.target.

globals.name: entity
globals.doc: The entity this script is attached to.

globals.name: game
globals.doc: The game: find/spawn entities, variables, scenes...

globals.name: props
globals.doc: Values set in the Inspector for this object, e.g. props.speed. Declare them with const properties = { speed: 2, target: object() } and every object using the script shows those fields; an object() property is the chosen object itself (or null).

globals.name: THREE
globals.doc: The three.js library, e.g. game.three.scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material)). Same as import * as THREE from "three".

globals.name: RAPIER
globals.doc: The physics library (Rapier), e.g. RAPIER.JointData.fixed(…) with game.rapier.world. Same as import * as RAPIER from "rapier".
